newsitem.title: USA: Read-Rite up as investors absorb good news.
newsitem.headline: Read-Rite up as investors absorb good news.

text.p: Read-Rite Corp shares enjoyed a rally Tuesday as investors began to digest the positive news surrounding the disk drive component maker, analysts said.
"You may not have had institutions get into the company thoroughly last week. People have had a few days to give it some attention," said Cody Acree, an analyst with Olde Discount Corp.
"There's a positive view behind Read-Rite," Acree said.
Read-Rite, which makes thin-film magnetic recording heads for computer disk drives, gained 1-3/8, to 29-1/2, in heavy trading.

Last week, Read-Rite's first quarter earnings surpassed analysts' expectations. The company posted first quarter earnings of $5.8 million or $0.12 a share on net sales of $251.6 million. The Wall Street consensus earnings estimates was $0.01 a share.
In the 1995 first quarter, Read-Rite earned $42.6 milion or $0.88 a share on net sales of $299 million.
Several brokerage firms, including Robertson Stephens & Co and Goldman Sachs, then upgraded Read Rite, while PaineWebber raised its earnings estimates.
Read-Rite's strong first quarter earnings also suggested that the company's yield were improving, which would give the company a stronger foundation for growth, analysts said.
Read-Rite also got a boast Tuesday from a broader technology lead by International Business Machines Corp .

Analysts said rating upgrades in personal computer stocks such as Compaq Computer Corp and Dell Computer Corp also attracted investors to the sector, helping both computer manufacturer and component maker stocks.
